description: Spectrum SP22125 High-Sided Steel Tipping Cart - New Stock for the 2025 Season! With its huge, 408kg capacity and high-sided design, the tow-behind Spectrum SP22125 is capable of safely handling the heaviest and bulkiest loads encountered in the domestic arena. Compatible with any tractor mower or ATV with hitchpin-and-hole linkage, the great-value Spectrum SP22125 High-Sided Trailer runs on large, pneumatic-tyred wheels that provide superior rough-ground stability, and which won't mark delicate lawn surfaces. A tipping mechanism - controlled by foot pedal - simplifies and speeds-up the process of unloading; all-steel construction and a powder-coated finish confer the very best in robustness and durability, with ball-bearing wheel mounts and a strengthened axle contributing further in this regard.
